C-TOOL-HISTORY-COMPACTION-RECENT-WINDOW.IntentSummary: Rework tool-history-compaction protection and recoverability: add an absolute recent-message window (protectRecentMessages, default 8) anchored by message recency time with array-position fallback, stop retained tools from consuming the per-call protection budget, and persist full pruned outputs to $XDG_DATA_HOME/vvoc/tool-output/ with the path embedded in the prune marker (savePrunedOutput, default on). Keeps output-only non-destructive compaction, idempotence, strict schema v3 config, and the existing config keys.

T-001.Title: Config vocabulary: protectRecentMessages and savePrunedOutput keys, defaults, validation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: config.ts adds protectRecentMessages (non-negative int, default 8) and savePrunedOutput (boolean, default true) to ToolHistoryCompactionConfig and CONFIG_KEYS; unknown keys still fail loudly; assertBudgetsFit unchanged.

plugin-toggle-config.ts DEFAULT_TOOL_HISTORY_COMPACTION_ENTRY and defaultToolHistoryCompactionCopy include the two new keys; materializeToolHistoryCompactionEntry fills them conservatively without overwriting user values.
schema v3 tool-history-compaction object shape accepts protectRecentMessages (integer minimum 0) and savePrunedOutput (boolean); existing documents with old keys still validate.
Tests cover default resolution, custom values, invalid values fail loud, materialization conservatism, and schema acceptance.

T-002.Title: Recency-time window helper and transform rework

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New helper recentMessageIndexes(messages, count) returns the indices of the newest count messages by info.time (completed ?? created), tie-broken by array position; missing times fall back to array position order deterministically.
compactMessages protects every completed tool part whose message index is in the window unconditionally (before retention, readSlim, prune, and before remainingProtection accounting).
Outside the window: retained tools are skipped and do NOT decrement remainingProtection; remainingProtection decrements only for non-retained eligible parts; readSlim and prune apply as before.
The last-message protection is subsumed by the window (protectRecentMessages >= 1 always protects the newest message); firstMessage logic is removed.

Tests cover: window protects parallel batches and over-budget outputs inside the last N messages; retained tools outside window do not consume budget; shuffled array with preserved times protects the same newest messages; array without times uses position fallback.

T-003.Title: Disk-backed prune: saved-output module and marker path embedding

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New saved-output.ts exposes savedOutputDir(dataHomeOverride?), savedOutputPath(callID, dataHomeOverride?) (deterministic sanitized filename tool-<callID>.txt), and savePrunedOutputOnce(output, callID, dataHomeOverride?) that writes the file only when it does not already exist and returns the path or undefined.

pruneOutput gains an optional savedPath parameter; when present, the pruned output appends "Full output saved to: <path>" after the marker; PRUNE_MARKER and alreadyCompacted detection stay intact; min-savings accounting includes the appended note.
transform.ts passes the persisted path into pruneOutput for non-read pruned parts when config.savePrunedOutput is true; readSlim markers never write files (they already carry the source path).
Tests cover deterministic path per callID, write-once idempotence, marker containing the path, file content equals original output, no-write when disabled, and readSlim no-write.
Fresh targeted suite passes; bun run check, bun run build, bun run pack:check pass; grace lint/status green with the active bundle; final change-scoped assertion gate passes.
